code_version_note: the commit at build time, which precedes the commit that lands these files
method: Resnik similarity over the most informative common ancestor, rolled up best-match-average in both directions and normalised by the query set's self-score. Human associations only - no mouse, no zebrafish, no protein-interaction random walk. This is a reimplementation of hiPHIVE's human-only path and is not Exomiser output.

inputs.name: hp.obo
inputs.role: the ontology graph: ancestor closure and term labels

inputs.name: genes_to_phenotype.txt
inputs.role: gene to clinical feature, and the frequencies the information content is computed from
inputs.known_defect: rows whose gene symbol is a placeholder are dropped at parse time; in this release that is 375 rows spanning 7 distinct NCBI gene ids, which would otherwise fuse into one fabricated gene

licence: HPO is CC BY 4.0; cite PMID 33264411
patient_data: none. Inputs are public ontology files; the query is the eight HPO terms owned by src/mva/phenotype/terms.py. No genomic coordinate is involved.
